name: Political instability
value: Indonesia VP quit 11 Nov; no G20 collapse
summary: Indonesia's vice-president resigned over an eligibility dispute; the MPR will pick a successor within 60 days
state: Indonesia's Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka resigned, as reported on 11 Nov, after the Supreme Court on 30 Oct invalidated a school certificate he submitted for the 2024 election and more than 100 lawmakers backed a petition that could start impeachment (Mothership; BusinessDay). The People's Consultative Assembly must choose a successor from two candidates nominated by President Prabowo within 60 days. This is a constitutional succession, not a government collapse, and searches on 14 Nov found no G20 coup or contested election.
for_you: No G20 government has collapsed. Travellers to Indonesia can check FCDO travel advice for any guidance on protests.
